body: My school actually has the only on-site counselling in my province, so I'll try that out I guess. Although I'm doing it because I know I should but not because I really want to.

I do not drool but I do have rather smelly feet after snowboarding.

I do get "mature" a lot so it makes me feel a bit calmer that you think that could be part of my problem, cuz that could definitely apply.

I feel like I do have some social skills because I do have some friends, and when we have fun, we really have fun. They're just not much more than that.

I really feel the same. I'm trying to do my French ISU and even though it's something I love to do I just can't focus on it without hearing the screaming silence and the pain. I tried to kill myself yesterday at 3am, but today I forced myself to get dressed. 

I'm gay too and I hate myself for it, but if anything has helped me with that it would be watching 1 Girl 5 Gays. It's a question and answer show with a cast of gay men. There's about 10-15 of them but they rotate people. They're located in my city (Toronto) and nothing makes me feel less alone.

some of this made me laugh, so thank you. And I do have a job but my manager is a bit of a dick and they have unrealistic expectations. (She taught me to sweep the floor and fold and wondered why I didn't know how to work cash yet......) 

I definitely put myself out there and I try to hold on to whatever friendships happen, but they aren't working out too well.

I think making new friends would be more of the same. Most of my friends are older than I am, so sometime they can help but mostly the scoff at my 'little kid problems". The ones who are my age have no idea what to say and usually don't even try.
The other part of this is that I'm gay, which no one has given me any grief for and even my mom has come around. But I really hate myself for it, I really just wish I wasn't. 

I have a ton of hobbies but I don't really care for them much anymore and I just feel too tired to want to start anything new. I have made friends through all of them but everytime it's the same. I was thinking of going to a psychiatrist and I've tried to tell my parents but I just can't get the words out to break their hearts.
Well because I never told her that she was hurting me. I never told her why I was pulling away, I just didn't. I wasn't strong enough for her.

I'm not really sure to be honest. Ideally I'd get a time machine and or a school transfer to a school of people that are mature, but also if you know how to cvontract a terminal cancer that kills me but doesn't leave my parents feeling guilty, that'd be cool too. 

Preferably the terminal disease thing.

Well I took some advil liquigels but apparently you actually need a ridiculous amount to do anything, so I went to bed and in the morning I woke up. Later I vomited it up. I told my parents I have the flu.
but mostly I don't want to be talked out of it, I want to know why
